description: This PHP source file defines the SignatureProvider class within the AWS SDK, providing methods for resolving, creating, and caching signature objects used for request authentication. It includes logic for handling different signature versions and external dependencies related to AWS signature mechanisms.

classes.name: SignatureProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods for resolving, creating, and caching AWS signature objects based on version, service, and region.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a signature provider to produce a SignatureInterface or BearerTokenAuthorization, throwing an exception if unable.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns a default, memoized signature provider.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a signature provider with caching to avoid recreating signature objects for the same parameters.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Creates signature objects based on known signature versions such as v4, v4a, v4-unsigned-body, bearer, and anonymous.
